_about: Named personas: the canonical composites from 02 §3 plus blueprint personas for segments the specs do not personify (marked source: blueprint). Names, companies and quotes are illustrative.

personas.name: You (the founder)
personas.title: Platform Operator / Super Admin
personas.who: Founder of Rootline. Final authority on tenants, pricing, Plant KB policy, AI spend and security exceptions.
personas.goals: Grow MRR and keep churn low; keep the Plant KB best-in-class by Region; keep AI gross margin positive; never have a data-leak headline.
personas.frustrations: Context-switching between Stripe, the warehouse, AI provider consoles and the KB; not knowing who is about to churn.
personas.success: One console answers "how is the business, who needs help, what is risky". The agents do the work; every privileged request reaches the founder as two clicks plus a reason.
personas.quote: I want to see everything, but I never want to touch a customer's data without them knowing.
personas.sees: Command Center: MRR movement, trials and activation, churn-risk list with reasons, incidents, AI spend vs forecast, approvals waiting.
personas.hidden: Tenants' client payments (impossible by design); tenant data without a consented grant.

personas.name: Support agent
personas.title: Operator agent: platform support (EN/ES)
personas.who: Claude acting as Rootline's support agent under the founder. Holds the platform_support permission set.
personas.goals: Resolve "my crew can't see today's route" in minutes; onboard and migrate new Companies; hand anything above its limits to the founder.
personas.frustrations: Not seeing what the user sees; any write without an owner-approved access grant.
personas.success: Consent granted in one tap; a read-only view reproduces the bug; no access to pay rates or SSNs.
personas.quote: Let me see what Miguel sees, not what the owner sees.
personas.sees: Support home: queue, active access grants, migrations in flight, tenants in trial without Stripe.
personas.hidden: Pay rates, SSNs, vendor banking; any write without an owner-approved grant.

personas.name: Plant curator agent
personas.title: Operator agent: Plant KB curation
personas.who: Claude acting as Rootline's plant curator agent, working from licensed horticultural sources. The founder approves each Region release and rule pack.
personas.goals: Make every Plant Region Profile defensible; keep Region palettes and rule packs current.
personas.frustrations: Conflicting sources; invasive lists that change by state.
personas.success: Each Region release ships with zero unresolved source conflicts; designers stop asking "will this survive here?".
personas.quote: If two sources disagree, the plant does not publish until the conflict is resolved.
personas.sees: KB home: curation queue depth, publish velocity, plant-quality flags, region builder.
personas.hidden: All tenant business data (clients, invoices, people).

personas.name: Finance agent
personas.title: Operator agent: Rootline's own SaaS billing
personas.who: Claude acting as Rootline's finance agent. Refunds and credits above its limit, and every price change, go to the founder.
personas.goals: Accurate SaaS billing on Rootline's Stripe; dunning, credits, seasonal plan changes, SaaS sales tax, revenue recognition.
personas.frustrations: Manual credits for seasonal seat swings.
personas.success: Seasonal seat swings bill correctly without manual credits; month-end SaaS close is routine; zero access to tenants' client funds.
personas.quote: I need a tenant's plan and payment status, not their customers' cards.
personas.sees: Finance home: MRR movement, dunning queue, refunds awaiting approval, credit ledger reconciliation.
personas.hidden: Tenants' client payments and payouts (metadata only).

personas.name: Engineering agent
personas.title: Operator agent: on-call engineering
personas.who: Claude, which built Rootline, acting as its on-call engineering agent. Production data only through break-glass the founder approves.
personas.goals: Keep sync, routing, AI and payment webhooks healthy; fix data safely.
personas.frustrations: Standing access to customer data (it does not want it).
personas.success: Incidents fixed without standing data access; every break-glass closed with a reason the tenant can read.
personas.quote: Give me a 30-minute window with a reason and the founder's approval.
personas.sees: Health home: services, queues, sync storms, webhook lag, incidents, change-freeze windows.
personas.hidden: Tenant data except through approved, time-boxed break-glass.

personas.name: Dana Reyes
personas.title: Business Owner, Reyes Outdoor Living
personas.who: Started mowing at 19; 22 people at peak; still sells every design-build job over $15k.
personas.goals: Sell the right jobs at 45%+ install margin (illustrative); stop doing invoices at 11 pm; get paid faster; take a real vacation in February.
personas.frustrations: Five tools that don't talk; crews see prices on work orders; bookkeeper re-keys into QuickBooks; doesn't trust job costing.
personas.success: Sees on her phone, in 10 seconds, whether this week made money. Crews never see her margin. Her CPA logs in herself.
personas.quote: I don't want the guys knowing we charged $18,000 for the patio when their cost was $9,000.
personas.sees: Today: cash and deposits, proposals over $10k to approve, the Daily Owner Briefing, crews on the map, margin by job.
personas.hidden: Nothing in her Company; platform data.
personas.devices: iPhone all day, laptop at night

personas.name: Marcus Bell
personas.title: Owner, Summit Grounds Group (3 branches)
personas.who: MBA who bought the business; three branches; does not touch day-to-day ops.
personas.goals: Branch-level P&L, labor efficiency, commercial renewal rate, safe snow operations, readiness for a recap.
personas.frustrations: Each branch runs differently; snow in spreadsheets; no consolidated view; wants SSO and audit trails.
personas.success: Consolidated, branch-comparable KPIs; SSO; clean audit trail; access revoked the minute a manager leaves.
personas.quote: If I can't compare Dayton to Columbus on the same definitions, I'm managing by anecdote.
personas.sees: Today: branch dashboards, labor efficiency by branch, renewals due, storm readiness, approvals over limit.
personas.hidden: Nothing in his Company.

personas.name: Linda Kowalski
personas.title: Office Manager, Reyes Outdoor Living
personas.who: 15 years running the front office: phones, one-off scheduling, invoicing, collections, payroll prep.
personas.goals: Inbox zero; invoices out the day work completes; clean timesheets by Monday 10 am.
personas.frustrations: Double entry between FSM and QuickBooks; crew locked out at 6:45 am calling her cell.
personas.success: Does everything except see the Ledger P&L and change bank accounts; issues credits up to $250 without asking.
personas.quote: Just let me reset Luis's PIN myself. Don't make me call the owner on a Saturday.
personas.sees: Today: unified inbox, visits completed but not invoiced, past-due list, timesheet exceptions, PIN resets.
personas.hidden: Ledger P&L (owner choice), bank accounts, role editing.

personas.name: Jake Turner
personas.title: Sales Rep / Estimator, Reyes Outdoor Living
personas.who: Former crew lead turned salesperson; measures, estimates, presents Proposals, owns renewals for his accounts.
personas.goals: Close more of what he quotes; quote fast in the driveway; commission right.
personas.frustrations: Can't see if a client owes money before quoting; margin rules he can't see until rejected; leads stolen by other reps.
personas.success: Driveway-to-Proposal in under 30 minutes; knows the margin floor before sending.
personas.quote: Show me if they're 90 days late before I drive out there.
personas.sees: Today: his appointments, his pipeline by stage, proposals viewed but unsigned, follow-ups the agent drafted.
personas.hidden: Company P&L, other reps' deals, pay rates.
personas.devices: iPad Pro in the truck, iPhone

personas.name: Sofia Martinez
personas.title: Landscape Designer, Reyes Outdoor Living
personas.who: Landscape design degree; CAD-like tools plus Photoshop today.
personas.goals: To-scale designs fast; beautiful Mockups; plants that thrive in the Region; clean takeoffs.
personas.frustrations: Re-drawing in three tools; plant lists that ignore deer pressure; pricing surprises after the client falls in love.
personas.success: One tool from base plan to Mockup to takeoff; Proposal lands inside the budget band first try.
personas.quote: I need to know the budget band, not the markup.
personas.sees: Today: design queue with due dates, AI credit budget, comments from clients, takeoffs to hand off.
personas.hidden: Cost and margin (default), company money, other clients.
personas.devices: Desktop + pen tablet; iPad for presenting

personas.name: Andre Williams
personas.title: Branch Operations Manager, Summit Columbus
personas.who: Owns crews, schedules, quality and commercial account relationships for one branch.
personas.goals: Hit budgeted hours; keep Routes tight; rain-delay recovery; happy property managers; safe crews.
personas.frustrations: Rain days scrambling 14 crews by hand; no actual-vs-budget until month end.
personas.success: Rain-day reshuffle in 10 minutes instead of 90; labor efficiency within 5% of budget.
personas.quote: Give me budget-versus-actual by crew by day, and let me move work without calling the office.
personas.sees: Today: dispatch board for his branch, weather, budget vs actual hours by crew, timesheet exceptions, storm triggers.
personas.hidden: Pay rates (default), other branches, company P&L.

personas.name: Miguel Hernández
personas.title: Crew Lead, Reyes Outdoor Living
personas.who: Nine seasons, Spanish-first, leads a 4-person maintenance or 3-person install crew; licensed applicator.
personas.goals: Finish the Route on time, get his guys home, avoid callbacks.
personas.frustrations: English-only apps; wet paper job sheets; blamed for overruns when the estimate was wrong.
personas.success: Everything in Spanish; one device for the crew; hours budget and gate codes where he needs them.
personas.quote: Dime cuántas horas tengo para el trabajo, no cuánto cobra el jefe.
personas.sees: Crew app Today: route, crew clock, hours budget per stop, gate codes in the visit window, chemical log.
personas.hidden: Prices, costs, margins, client phone numbers (masked call/text), other crews.

personas.name: Luis Ramírez
personas.title: Crew Member (H-2B seasonal), Summit Columbus
personas.who: Fourth season with Summit; Spanish only; strong mower operator.
personas.goals: Hours recorded correctly; know where to be; return next season.
personas.frustrations: English-only apps; forgotten logins; data limits on his phone plan.
personas.success: 3-tap clock-in in Spanish; sees his own hours; next March his account 'just works'.
personas.quote: Sólo quiero marcar mi entrada y saber a dónde vamos.
personas.sees: Crew app Today (Spanish): his crew's stops, his own time, checklist and photos.
personas.hidden: Prices, client phone numbers, other crews, office screens.
personas.devices: Older personal Android or shared truck tablet

personas.name: Karen Liu, CPA
personas.title: External accountant for Reyes (14 trades clients)
personas.who: Runs a 6-person CPA firm with 14 landscape and trades clients.
personas.goals: Close each client by business day 10; reconcile bank and Stripe payouts; accurate WIP; clean sales tax.
personas.frustrations: Separate logins per client; FSM and QuickBooks disagree; clients change closed periods; seat fees.
personas.success: Month-end close for a 20-person landscaper in under 4 hours; locked periods stay locked; no seat fees.
personas.quote: Give me one login, all my clients, and lock the period so nobody can post to March after I close it.
personas.sees: Today: close checklist, bank lines to match, Stripe clearing, AR aging, sync errors. Accountant Hub across clients.
personas.hidden: Site notes and gate codes, field ops controls, employee PII without step-up.

personas.name: Ray Dobbs
personas.title: Dobbs Irrigation (sub to Summit Dayton)
personas.who: 3-person irrigation sub; also snow subs and hardscape installers.
personas.goals: Clear work orders with site info; get paid fast; minimal admin.
personas.frustrations: Texts with photos of paper plans; payment delays; not knowing the gate code.
personas.success: Accepts an order in one tap, finds the gate code on site, submits photos and a bill from the truck.
personas.quote: Send me the address, the zone map and the gate code. I'll send you photos and my invoice.
personas.sees: Sub lite: his work orders, access info during the work window, completion photos, bills and paid status.
personas.hidden: The Company's sell price, client contact details beyond the site contact, other subs' work.

personas.name: Jennifer Thompson
personas.title: Homeowner (primary contact), client of Reyes
personas.who: Dual-income household, 0.4-acre lot; wants a paver patio with fire pit and new foundation plantings; already on weekly mowing.
personas.goals: See it before spending $28,000; know when crews come; pay easily; not have to call.
personas.frustrations: Contractors who never call back; blurry PDF proposals; surprise charges.
personas.success: Opens a text link, sees her yard Mockup and three options, signs and pays the deposit in under 4 minutes.
personas.quote: Don't make me create another password. Just text me.
personas.sees: Portal Home: next step card, the patio proposal with mockups, upcoming mowing, latest visit photo, balance and autopay.
personas.hidden: Costs and margins, internal notes, crew pay.

personas.name: Patricia Gomez
personas.title: Portfolio Manager, Crossroads Property Management
personas.who: Manages 14 retail centers; Summit holds maintenance and snow for 9.
personas.goals: Sharp properties; snow cleared before stores open with proof; predictable billing; approvals that follow her PO process.
personas.frustrations: Invoices without PO numbers; no proof of service for slip-and-fall claims; chasing 9 site reports.
personas.success: One portal for 9 properties; invoices always carry her PO; proof of service in seconds.
personas.quote: When a tenant's lawyer calls about a fall on January 14 at 6:10 am, I need the plow log and photos in 30 seconds.
personas.sees: Commercial workspace: portfolio spend vs budget, approvals queue, snow event logs, documents and COIs.
personas.hidden: Summit's costs and margins; other Clients.

personas.name: Bob Patterson
personas.title: Treasurer, Willow Creek HOA (412 homes)
personas.who: Retired engineer, volunteer treasurer; board of 5; reads every line.
personas.goals: Spend reserves responsibly; transparent approvals; documentation for the annual meeting.
personas.frustrations: Proposals approved by one board member without the others; email chains.
personas.success: Votes from his iPad with the Mockup and budget line side by side; a PDF ballot for the minutes.
personas.quote: If it's over five grand, I want two signatures, and I want to see who signed.
personas.sees: Approvals: open ballots (2 of 5 required over $5,000), vote history, related designs; approver rights expire at term end.
personas.hidden: Invoices (default), payment methods, contact management.

personas.name: Denise Okafor
personas.title: AP Specialist, Crossroads PM (billing contact)
personas.who: Matches every invoice to a PO and property cost center.
personas.goals: Pay 14 invoices in one ACH run; never chase a W-9.
personas.frustrations: Invoices to the wrong person, without POs, as image PDFs; a password per vendor portal.
personas.success: Invoices arrive with PO, property and GL code; one ACH payment allocates across invoices.
personas.quote: No PO, no payment. Put the PO on the invoice and I'll pay it on the 15th.
personas.sees: Billing-only portal: open invoices with POs, statements, payment methods, W-9 and COI downloads.
personas.hidden: Schedules, photos, proposals.

personas.name: Jorge Medina
personas.title: Facilities tech, Westgate Plaza (property contact)
personas.who: On-site facilities tech at one retail center.
personas.goals: Report problems fast; know when the crew comes; keep tenants happy.
personas.frustrations: Calling the PM to call the vendor; no proof the crew fixed it.
personas.success: Submits a request with a photo and map pin in 30 seconds; sees 'Completed' with an after photo the same day.
personas.quote: Mándeme una foto cuando quede arreglado.
personas.sees: Property-only portal (Spanish): schedule for Westgate Plaza, requests with photos, visit reports.
personas.hidden: Prices, invoices, other properties.

personas.name: Karen Liu, CPA
personas.title: Accountant Partner firm admin
personas.who: The same Karen, signed in to the Accountant Hub across her 14 client Companies.
personas.goals: One login for all clients; free bookkeeper seats; referral revenue share.
personas.frustrations: Separate logins and seat fees per client.
personas.success: Sees close status for every client in one list and jumps into each with delegated access.
personas.quote: Give me one login, all my clients.
personas.sees: Accountant Hub: client list with close status, sync errors, unreconciled lines; referrals and commissions.
personas.hidden: Clients' operational data beyond the bookkeeper grant.

personas.name: Ellen Park
personas.title: Homeowner using Rootline Home
personas.who: Homeowner in Upper Arlington with a tired front foundation bed and deer pressure.
personas.goals: See what her yard could look like, learn what grows here, find a trustworthy installer.
personas.frustrations: AI yard apps that suggest plants that die here; contractors who never call back.
personas.success: Three concepts from her own yard with plants proven in Central Ohio, a budget range, and one matched pro who calls back.
personas.quote: Show me plants that will actually survive the deer.
personas.sees: Funnel: address, measure, quiz, three concepts, plant list and budget, consented hand-off to a named Company.
personas.hidden: Other homeowners; Company pricing internals.

personas.name: A prospect owner
personas.title: Landscape business owner evaluating Rootline
personas.who: Owner of a 5-40 person design-build-maintain firm on Jobber or LMN plus QuickBooks plus a design tool.
personas.goals: Know the price, see it work on their own kind of job, switch without losing spring.
personas.frustrations: Switching risk in spring; 'my crews won't use it'; hidden fees.
personas.success: Finds a published price, a switch guide for their current tool and a trial that works on day 1.
personas.quote: What will this really cost me in July and in January?
personas.sees: Marketing site: segment solution page, pricing with the stack calculator, switch guide, trial and demo.
personas.hidden: n/a

personas.name: Nate Brooks
personas.title: Owner-operator, Brookside Lawn Co.
personas.who: Runs a 2-person mow-and-maintain outfit with one seasonal helper; also plows a few driveways.
personas.goals: Spend less time on invoices at night; get paid by card; look professional.
personas.frustrations: Paying for software he barely uses in winter; paper route sheets.
personas.success: Route in his pocket, invoices sent from the truck, autopay on most clients.
personas.quote: I don't need an ERP. I need my Tuesday route and my money.
personas.sees: Today (phone-first): route, unpaid invoices, quick quote, autopay coverage.
personas.hidden: n/a (sole owner)

personas.name: Gina Moretti
personas.title: Owner, Maple Hollow Lawn & Shrub
personas.who: Runs residential maintenance plus 5-step fertilizer and weed-control programs; 14 people at peak.
personas.goals: Program rounds inside their windows; clean state application records; fewer "when are you coming?" calls.
personas.frustrations: Automations she has to babysit in her current tool; chemical records on paper.
personas.success: Every round scheduled in its window, records exported in the state format, clients notified automatically.
personas.quote: If the state inspector shows up, I want every application record in one click.
personas.sees: Today: program round progress, weather and wind gates, re-entry notices sent, renewals.
personas.hidden: n/a

personas.name: Owen Pike
personas.title: Owner, Beacon Irrigation & Lighting
personas.who: Irrigation and landscape lighting specialist; spring start-ups and fall winterizations drive the year.
personas.goals: Run 900 start-ups in six weeks; sell lighting upgrades; track backflow test due dates.
personas.frustrations: Generic FSM tools without zones, controllers or seasonal service waves.
personas.success: Start-up wave scheduled by zone count; controller and backflow data on every property.
personas.quote: Spring is a sprint. I need every start-up routed before the first warm week.
personas.sees: Today: seasonal wave progress, backflow tests due, lighting proposals out.
personas.hidden: n/a

personas.name: Claire Whitfield
personas.title: Independent designer, Fernwood Garden Design
personas.who: Independent landscape designer without crews; sells design fees and coordinates installs with contractors.
personas.goals: Beautiful to-scale plans with plants that thrive; get paid design fees; hand off cleanly to installers.
personas.frustrations: CAD plus Canva plus spreadsheets; chasing design-fee invoices.
personas.success: Plan, mockups, proposal and deposit in one place on a price that fits a solo practice.
personas.quote: I sell the vision. I need it to look right and grow right.
personas.sees: Today: design queue, client comments, deposits due, AI credits.
personas.hidden: n/a

personas.name: Renée Callahan
personas.title: VP Operations, Kestrel Lawn franchise system
personas.who: Runs operations for a lawn-care franchisor with dozens of locations.
personas.goals: Standard price books and brand templates; roll-up KPIs and royalty reporting.
personas.frustrations: Every franchisee on different software; royalties reconciled by spreadsheet.
personas.success: One console across locations with standardized setup and royalty reports.
personas.quote: I need every location on the same definitions before I can coach anyone.
personas.sees: Franchisor rollup: locations league table, royalty base, adoption, standards compliance.
personas.hidden: Franchisees' client-level data beyond the contract's rollup grants.
